full_page.content:
P.S. - after return from Texas and Washington. May 15th.
"I walked down the Valley of Silence; down the dim voiceless val'y alone And I heard not the fall of a footstep around me, save God's & my own,
"I walked in the world with the worldly. I craved what the W. never gave And I said "In the world each ideal that shines like as star on life' wave Is wrecked on the shores of the real and sleeps like a dream in a grave
Do you ask me the place of the Valley, ye hearts that are burdened with care It lieth afar between mountains, and God and His angels are there; And one is the dark Mount of Sorrow; and one the bright Mountain of Prayer.'
Pardon for spoiling the Blind Poet, Father Ryan's beautiful "Song of the Mistic". I undertook to memorize it some years ago and just lately again. I find it a sort of nerve tonic from the tales of misfortune and of sorrow and disapointment so almost continually brought to the Monastery Office. .. Since the above - upto and including manuscript - took its air trip on April 9th I have received official information of Fr. E'd's well being and good work Deo grt.
It just returned from Washing (dead letter branch) this a.m. ... Fr. Solanus
